📌 今日英语任务
✅ 四级英语：List 1
✅ 考研单词：新60 + 旧100
✅ 多邻国：1个小单元打卡
📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇 English: A clear goal can guide our actions and help us overcome difficulties. When we face a hard task, we should not abandon it easily. Instead, we need to analyze the problem, absorb useful advice, and take practical steps. Progress may be slow, but steady effort will eventually produce a satisfying result. Therefore, we should maintain confidence and keep moving forward. 中文翻译： 清晰的目标能指引我们的行动，帮助我们克服困难。当我们面对艰巨任务时，不应轻易放弃。相反，我们需要分析问题、吸收有用建议，并采取切实步骤。进步可能缓慢，但持续努力终会产生令人满意的结果。因此，我们应保持信心，继续前进。 重点词汇： goal 目标；guide 指引；overcome 克服；difficulty 困难；abandon 放弃；analyze 分析；absorb 吸收；advice 建议；practical 切实的；progress 进步；steady 持续的；eventually 最终；produce 产生；satisfying 令人满意的；maintain 保持；confidence 信心。
✅ 每日自测
每日自测 一、中译英 1. 清晰的目标能指引我们的行动。 2. 我们不应轻易放弃艰巨任务。 3. 持续努力终会产生令人满意的结果。 二、英译中 1. We should analyze the problem and absorb useful advice. 2. Progress may be slow, but steady effort matters. 3. We should maintain confidence and keep moving forward. 三、句子填空 1. A clear goal can ____ our actions and help us ____ difficulties. 2. We need to take ____ steps and ____ confidence.

📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇 English: In the pursuit of success, we must not ignore the value of persistence. Many people abandon their goals when difficulties arise, but those who endure eventually achieve remarkable results. A wise person once said that ability may take you to the top, but character keeps you there. Therefore, we should cultivate both competence and integrity, and never cease to improve ourselves. 中文翻译： 在追求成功的过程中，我们不能忽视坚持的价值。许多人在困难出现时放弃目标，但那些坚持到底的人最终会取得显著成果。一位智者曾说，能力也许能把你带到顶峰，但品格才能让你留在那里。因此，我们应同时培养能力与正直，并永不停止自我提升。 重点词汇： pursuit n. 追求 ignore v. 忽视 persistence n. 坚持 abandon v. 放弃 arise v. 出现 endure v. 忍耐；坚持 remarkable adj. 显著的 ability n. 能力 character n. 品格 cultivate v. 培养 competence n. 能力；胜任 integrity n. 正直 cease v. 停止 improve v. 提升
✅ 每日自测
每日自测 一、中译英 1. 坚持是成功的关键。 2. 我们不能忽视品格的重要性。 3. 许多人遇到困难时放弃目标。 二、英译中 1. Ability may take you to the top. 2. Character keeps you there. 3. We should never cease to improve ourselves. 三、句子填空 1. Many people ______ their goals when difficulties arise. 2. We should cultivate both competence and ______.
